name: M7.Presentation.leastOf_spec
statement: ∀ (α : Type) [LinearOrder α] (T : Finset α), (∀ x, M7.Presentation.leastOf T = some x ↔ x ∈ T ∧ ∀ y ∈ T, x ≤ y) ∧ (M7.Presentation.leastOf T = none ↔ T = ∅)
guidance: Split T.Nonempty in leastOf; Finset.min'_mem/min'_le give soundness. Conversely uniqueness of the minimum follows by le_antisymm. Empty case uses Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty. Handle proof-irrelevance of nonempty witnesses normally. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.
